div.p: The rooms at Hotel Arena are marked by a fresh, modern design. Each room has its own bathroom, satellite television, a safe and individually controlled air conditioning. A lift provides step-free access to every floor of the hotel.

section.class: s_rooms_listing s_ha_rooms_listing o_cc o_cc1 pt104 pb104 o_colored_level

div.p: A comfortable double room with either two separate beds or a double bed. The room has air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, satellite television and a safe.
A barrier-free double room with full access for guests with reduced mobility. A lift provides step-free access to every floor of the hotel.
A spacious family room with 4 beds. Suitable for families with children or groups of friends.
A luxury room with two queen size beds. It offers maximum comfort and elegance for discerning guests.

div.p: The newly built Hotel Arena stands in the sports and relaxation centre in Zadní Vinohrady on the edge of Chomutov, letting guests spend their free time actively right next to the unique Kamencové Lake.
The hotel is furnished in a modern design with a total capacity of 210 beds. Several of the 96 double rooms are barrier-free.

div.p: Everything you need for a carefree stay.
A generous breakfast buffet every morning.
Brazilian and international cuisine.
CCTV monitored, free of charge.
Throughout the hotel, rooms included.
Information about the area and trip suggestions.
Safe storage before check-in and after check-out.
For an extra charge, ready the next day.
Flexible times on request.

section.class: s_surroundings s_ha_surroundings o_cc o_cc2 pt104 pb104 o_colored_level

div.p: We offer you the chance to combine rest and entertainment right beside the remarkable Kamencové Lake, whatever the weather or season.
Other options include a training hall and a children's playground. In season, water skiing is available at the Wake Park next to Kamencové Lake.

div.h2: Brazilian cuisine right in the hotel

div.h3: Authentic flavours of Brazil by chef Rafael
div.p: Restaurante Brasileiro brings Brazilian cooking with an international reach to the heart of Hotel Arena. Chef Rafael serves authentic recipes from Brazil alongside Czech and international specialities.
Seating for 110 including 2 private lounges and a summer terrace with 60 seats. There is also a bar, ideal for meetings and business talks.
